mike_r: Bringing up athena-3b-int4 on staging. Need a small audit slab promptset + labeling window to smoke test hallucination regressions. Suggest ~800 samples — stratified by longform / multi-turn / code. Who can own?
eva: I can carve a slab from seedbank. Recommend 600 NL + 200 code. We'll do a 1:1 paraphrase de-dupe pass. ETA ~24h.
liz: Label ops can take a 48h microburst with 4 labelers. Need instructions + edge-case checklist. Also: tagging schema? thinking `regress/halluc/ok`?
sanjay: Model infra: deploy is ready, int4 kernel mapping applied. Note: KV-cache differences can surface as prefix divergence; include very short and very long prefixes in slab.
label-bot: label-bot: created job audit_slab_1794440000, est throughput 450/hr.
mike_r: Thanks. Eva, include ~70% longcontext (>512 tokens) and 30% short. Also add 100 examples pulled from past hallucination hits for calibration.
eva: Pulling seeds now. Doing paraphrase de-dupe with fuzzyhash threshold 0.82 and provenance tags. Uploading candidate manifest. ETA ~6h for candidate list.
liz: Drafting labeling instructions. Key fields: 1) factuality, 2) hallucination type (fabrication / contradiction / omission), 3) severity (1-4), 4) reproduction steps. Want reviewers.
nana: (typo correction) ana: I'll review the instructions. Also suggest adding an "explains-self" prompt variant to catch attribution errors.
mike_r: Good idea. Ops: when you flip the int4 kernel in staging, can you keep automatic fallback to fp16 on any request that spikes >1s to avoid noisy end-user regressions?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout athena-3b-int4 -> staging succeeded (3/3 hosts). Observability hooks attached.
sanjay: Quick perf note: int4 throughput +2.2x, but 95p latency for longctx increased ~12%. Seeing more sampling noise on some prompts. We'll correlate with prompt variants.
liz: Labelers ready. Uploading instruction doc + example pack: 
```text
Label schema:
- factuality: yes/no
- error_type: fabrication|contradiction|omission|other
- severity: 1-4
- notes: free text
```
eva: Candidate list uploaded to s3://redwood-internal/curation/audit_slab_1794440000/candidates.csv (with provenance columns).
mike_r: Perfect. After label pass: run eval harness with refset + faithfulness metrics (precision/recall on hallucination tags) and compute diffs vs baseline athena-v1. Output to /tmp/audit179444 and link results here.
label-bot: label-bot: first batch (200 samples) assigned to team, ETA ~6h.
nana: (again) ana: one more ask — add a 10-sample manual RAG edge-case bucket (questions that trigger external retrieval).
mike_r: Added. We'll reconvene when labels hit ~60% complete. Thx all :thumbsup:
